user_question: Use confirmed wave-bottom connections, not transform filters, to study where nine ordered child-wave combinations occur within coarser graphical structures.

hypotheses.H1: Child nine-grid distributions may differ conditional on previously observable coarse graphical context.
hypotheses.H0: No robust conditional differences beyond sampling, dependence, extraction rules and qualification effects.
hypotheses.macro_trend_is_only_cause: not assumed; cannot be proved by a same-price observational decomposition
hypotheses.no_macro_implies_identical_cycles: idealized assumption, not a mathematical necessity

skeleton.nodes: wick lows at the close-selected pivot bars of confirmed complete A-waves
skeleton.edge: each original A-wave low-to-low bottom segment
skeleton.first_start_node_availability: conservatively first complete wave confirmation; no earlier availability invented
skeleton.gaps_and_resets: never connect across root epoch or missing shared anchor; never revive old context after reset

parent_graph.method: causal temporal-maturity turning points on arriving confirmed lower-low nodes; low-high-low waves recursively formed on this polyline
parent_graph.maturity_clock: node count, explicitly not uniformly spaced time or cycles per bar
parent_graph.geometry_clock: original child-bar coordinates; store node spans separately
parent_graph.meaning: last completed confirmed coarse pair, not omniscient current market regime
parent_graph.top_bottom_names: upper/lower consolidation or turn candidates, never confirmed ultimate tops/bottoms
parent_graph.monotone_or_unconfirmed_parent: unresolved; never force a complete parent wave
parent_graph.new_parent_pivot_after_pair: invalidate phase qualification until a new complete parent pair
parent_graph.scale_qualification: post-formation diagnostic; never used to choose a convenient parent or pretend an ex-ante signal
parent_graph.parameter_status: explicit initial engineering hypothesis, not natural-frequency finding or empirical winner

primary_pre_formation.evidence_rule: all parent inputs and their confirmation evidence known at or before cutoff
primary_pre_formation.interpretation: pre-existing context of subsequently confirmed patterns; retrospective event selection, not a trading forecast or claim the pair start was recognizable then

diagnostic_pre_confirmation.interpretation: causal but may share earlier tested-wave inputs; not independent causal attribution

diagnostic_at_confirmation.interpretation: contemporaneous shared-source geometry; cannot substantiate macro causal explanation

information_views.join: backward by known_from_bar within exact source/view/config/root chain; never nearest/forward or occurrence-time join

analysis.unit: confirmed strict child pair; event weighted, not bar-duration exposure weighted
analysis.zero_support: null proportions, never invented zero probability

acceptance_and_sequence: S0: reviewed protocol, causal source APIs, synthetic causal/counterexample tests, PR and CI
S1: resolve upstream #274 baseline/input/visual dependencies; a frozen baseline descriptive pilot need not wait for a positive natural-cluster finding
S2: bind exact source/input/clock/output/resource manifests and independent verifier to standard workflow_dispatch; private receipt required
S3: equally detailed raw-OHLC and as-of skeleton/parent visual panels for all nine cells, unknowns and contradictory cases
S4: separately freeze dependence-aware null/sensitivity implementation before any inferential run; contrast pre-formation with overlapping views and amplitude/upper-envelope controls
S5: post-run descriptive/inferential adjudication; record unsupported and insufficient outcomes, no automatic production/trading authority

visual_plan.evidence: raw OHLC plus visible lower-wave pivots, all confirmed skeleton segments, parent pivot occurrence and confirmation markers, tested pair start/confirmation cutoffs
visual_plan.not_yet_known_segments: omit from causal view; retrospective teaching view must be separately watermarked
visual_plan.first_pack: deterministic id-hash sampling, up to 3 cases per populated child-by-context cell; shortages explicit; include invalid-context cases

execution.future_real_run_entry: public-compute.yml workflow_dispatch cloud-workspace-v1 exact reviewed allowlisted profile
execution.inference_model_and_resource_manifest: not registered; separate pre-run gate mandatory
